verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Templates API (create, edit, list), sending with templates by passing a `TemplateModel` of merge data, and a 'Validate a template' endpoint that serves as a pre-send test-render check. The evidence never documents the templating language itself, its conditionals or its loops, and the validate endpoint is only a title-level mention. Missing for 10: documented template syntax with conditionals and loops, detailed preview/test-render behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending
